mapper.select: SELECT count(MESSAGE_MST_NO) AS cnt FROM ${msg_table} WHERE MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '00' AND SEND_TYPE_CD = '${msg_type}' AND ( ETRS_MTCD = '01' OR (ETRS_MTCD = '02' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(SEND_EXPECTED_DT || SEND_EXPECTED_TIME, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') <= SYSTIMESTAMP) )
mapper.update: UPDATE ${msg_table} SET MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '01', MOD_DT = SYSTIMESTAMP, MOD_ID = #{mod_id} WHERE MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '00' AND SEND_TYPE_CD = '${msg_type}' AND ( ETRS_MTCD = '01' OR (ETRS_MTCD = '02' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(SEND_EXPECTED_DT || SEND_EXPECTED_TIME, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') <= SYSTIMESTAMP) ) AND ROWNUM <= 500
mapper.select: SELECT MESSAGE_MST_NO AS MSGID, 'AT' AS MSGTYPE, MESSAGE_CONTENT AS MSG, CASE WHEN RECEIVER_PHONE_NO LIKE '82%' THEN RECEIVER_PHONE_NO WHEN RECEIVER_PHONE_NO LIKE '010%' THEN '82' || SUBSTR(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO, 2) ELSE '82' || SUBSTR(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO, 2) END AS PHN, CASE WHEN LENGTH(trim(SENDER_PHONE_NO)) > 0 AND TRIM(SENDER_PHONE_NO) IS NOT NULL THEN SENDER_PHONE_NO ELSE '1355' END AS SENDER, BROF_CD AS PINVOICE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REGDT, MSG_TEMPLATE_CD AS TMPLID, CASE WHEN ETRS_MTCD = '01' THEN '00000000000000' WHEN ETRS_MTCD = '02' THEN SEND_EXPECTED_DT || SEND_EXPECTED_TIME ELSE '00000000000000' END AS RESERVEDT, CASE WHEN SYSTEM_CD = '4INSURE' THEN '${insure_profile_key}' WHEN SYSTEM_CD = 'FIBP' THEN '${fibp_profile_key}' ELSE '${nps_profile_key}' END AS PROFILEKEY, AD_FLAG AS ADFLAG, BUTTON_TYPE AS BTN_TYPE, BUTTON_NAME AS BTN_NAME, URL_PC_IOS AS BTN_PC, URL_MOBILE_ANDROID as BTN_MO, (SELECT SYSTEM_CD FROM TB_LINK_SYSTEM b WHERE b.SYSTEM_CD = a.SYSTEM_CD) AS SYSCD, CASE WHEN TO_DATE(SEND_EXPECTED_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN '0' ELSE '1' END AS DATEFLAG FROM ${msg_table} a WHERE SEND_TYPE_CD = '${msg_type}' AND MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '01'
mapper.update: update ${msg_table} set MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '02', SEND_DT = SYSTIMESTAMP, MOD_DT = SYSTIMESTAMP, MOD_ID = #{mod_id} where MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '01' and SEND_TYPE_CD = '${msg_type}'
